package querier

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/dskit/user"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/modules/overrides"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/search"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseIntrinsicDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
	o, err := overrides.NewOverrides(overrides.Config{}, nil, prometheus.NewRegistry())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Actual querier method, deliberately no ingester rings/backend/clients. Any
	// unexpected I/O path cannot silently return an empty successful dictionary.
	q := &Querier{limits: o}
	ctx := user.InjectOrgID(context.Background(), "fixture")
	type Case struct {
		Key      string `json:"key"`
		Response any    `json:"response"`
	}
	names := search.GetVirtualIntrinsicValues()
	sort.Strings(names)
	cases := []Case{{"", map[string]any{"scopes": []any{map[string]any{"name": "intrinsic", "tags": names}}}}}
	for _, key := range []string{"status", "span:status", "kind", "span:kind", "duration", "span:duration", "traceDuration"} {
		resp, err := q.SearchTagValuesV2(ctx, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesRequest{TagName: key})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if resp.Metrics == nil || resp.Metrics.InspectedBytes != 0 {
			t.Fatal("virtual values performed I/O")
		}
		vals := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
		vals = append(vals, resp.TagValues...)
		sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool { return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value })
		cases = append(cases, Case{key, map[string]any{"tagValues": vals}})
	}
	// Names may be vocabulary without static values. Do not invent empty results
	// for these: their actual querier path would need backend reads.
	for _, key := range []string{"trace:duration", "name", "span:name", "statusMessage", "span:statusMessage", "instrumentation:name", "resource.status", "span.kind", "status.code", "error"} {
		if search.GetVirtualTagValuesV2(key) != nil {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected virtual alias %s", key)
		}
	}
	for i, c := range cases {
		wire, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/tmp/pulse-tempo-intrinsics/result-%02d.protobuf", i))
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var got, want proto.Message
		if c.Key == "" {
			got = &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
			want = &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
		} else {
			got = &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
			want = &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
		}
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(c.Response)
		if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, want); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !proto.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("protobuf %d: %s vs %s", i, got, want)
		}
	}
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-tempo-intrinsics"
	if err = os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
